title: Python for Data Science
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Python for Data Science, covering data manipulation, visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI. Participants will learn how to use popular Python libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow to analyze data, extract insights, and build predictive models. The course is highly practical, with hands-on exercises and a capstone project.
audience: Aspiring Data Scientists & Analysts looking to build a strong foundation in Python
Software Developers who want to transition into Data Science
Business Analysts & Professionals seeking to leverage data for decision-making
Students & Researchers in fields requiring data analysis
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Practical exercises with real-world datasets
Live Demonstrations – Applying concepts to real case studies
Data Science Case Studies – Industry applications of Python
Collaborative Learning – Group projects and peer reviews
Capstone Project – Developing a complete data science solution
competencies: Data Manipulation & Cleaning using Pandas & NumPy
Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling using Scikit-learn
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Write Python scripts for data manipulation and analysis
Use Pandas & NumPy for data handling and preprocessing
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical analysis
Create data visualizations using Matplotlib & Seaborn
Apply Machine Learning techniques using Scikit-learn
Implement basic Deep Learning models using TensorFlow
Work on real-world data science problems

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Python for Data Science

items.text: Overview of Data Science and Python’s Role

items.text: Data Cleaning: Handling Missing Data, Duplicates, and Outliers
Working with NumPy for Numerical Computing

outline.title: Module 3: Data Visualization with Matplotlib & Seaborn

items.text: Creating Basic Charts (Line, Bar, Scatter, Pie, Histograms)
Advanced Visualizations: Box Plots, Heatmaps, Pair Plots
What is EDA and Why is it Important?
Identifying Trends, Patterns, and Anomalies in Data

outline.title: Module 6: Introduction to Machine Learning with Python

items.text: Preparing Data for Machine Learning Models

outline.title: Module 8: Deep Learning with TensorFlow & Keras (Intro)

items.text: Implementing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for Image Processing
Introduction to Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Python
